hints.title: Recursive Definition
hints.text: The greatest element in the array becomes the root. Everything to its left belongs to its left subtree, and everything to its right belongs to its right subtree.

hints.title: Parent-Child Relationship
hints.text: For each node, its parent is the smaller of the first greater element to its left and the first greater element to its right.

hints.title: Linear Decreasing Construction
hints.text: Iterate through numbers maintaining a decreasing sequence of nodes. When a larger value arrives, pop smaller nodes and make the last popped node its left child. Attach the new node as the right child of the top element remaining.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Linear time Cartesian tree construction maintaining a decreasing sequence of nodes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively finding the maximum in worst case sorted arrays takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A decreasing collection tracks parents and children in O(N) total push and pop steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the Cartesian tree property and solve it in O(N) using a monotonic sequence.
